exposure: partial pressure of carbon dioxide (PCO2) before extubation
fraction of inspired oxygen (FIO2) before extubation
outcome: extubation failures associated with respiratory problems
cohort: Extremely preterm infants born less than 28 weeks gestational age between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2022.
finding: PCO2 before extubation, FIO2 before extubation, and lower postmenstrual age at extubation were identified as significant risk factors for respiratory-related extubation failure in extremely preterm infants.
gest_age: less than 28 weeks gestational age (median 25.6 weeks)
